name: openclaude
one_liner: A universal remote-control terminal for AI coding assistants — one tool that talks to almost any AI model provider instead of locking you into one.
buyer: An engineering lead who wants their team using AI coding tools without being locked into a single vendor's pricing or outages.
business_use_cases: A dev shop standardizes every engineer on one CLI, then swaps the underlying model (OpenAI, Gemini, local Ollama) based on cost or client requirements without retraining anyone.
A consultancy offers 'bring your own model' AI-assisted development to clients who don't want their code touching a specific vendor's cloud.
An open-source maintainer runs it against a free local model to avoid per-token API costs while still getting agentic coding help.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a managed, pre-configured version with enterprise SSO and audit logs to companies that want multi-provider AI coding without the setup work.
Offer paid onboarding/consulting to help engineering teams migrate their AI workflows onto it.

steal_this: Package it with one well-documented local-model config (e.g. Ollama + a strong open model) and sell it as a 'zero API cost AI coding starter kit' to bootcamp grads.
